scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a city street with buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large building with a poster of a man in a white suit and a modern building with a sleek glass façade. The street is lined with trees and has a few pedestrians walking along the sidewalk, with a yellow traffic light and a security camera mounted on a pole. The sky is partly cloudy with patches of blue peeking through.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building on the left has a beige façade with a large window on the top floor and a poster of a man in a white suit below it. The building on the right has a more modern design with a glass façade and a flat roof. Both buildings have a similar height but differ in style and age.
scene_analysis.materials: The building on the left has a beige façade with a mix of stone and concrete elements, while the building on the right has a sleek glass façade with a metal frame.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few streetlights and a security camera mounted on a pole.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with tall trees that provide shade and add a touch of greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the buildings, including a large sign on the left side of the street that reads 'No Parking' and another sign on the right side that says 'One Way'. There are also several smaller signs and advertisements posted on the buildings.
